problems.root_cause: Anchor/splice patching without a semantic diff check; SQL in strings is invisible to typecheck; failing-test gaps target production files

problems.symptom: Substrate landings delete 2969 lines, inject placeholders at byte 0, crash-loop the vessel, break package deps
problems.root_cause: The drafter edits its own source (192 autonomous edits to feature-compose.ts). Gates were blind, which makes the corruption self-sealing.

problems.symptom: A fix landed and was later silently undone by another commit (autonomous or operator): --no-block, 8-hex class key, learning-mode controller, no-work-is-not-a-win, a0ff3d3
problems.root_cause: Nothing checks that a predecessor fix still holds when a later commit touches the same region. Stale-base staging and cutover overwrite are unguarded (97f7cdf: class still open).

problems.symptom: Autonomous landing breaks tsc or crash-loops goal-host (duplicate let, un-awaited async)
problems.root_cause: Signature-subset staticEvaluate is not a full cross-file tsc. Full-file cutover from a stale base.

problems.symptom: Substrate landings break or oscillate: schemas ping-pong in 4 minutes, /health env-gate flip x3, syntax break + build output commit, re-enabled a disabled mint path, load-time placeholder blanking
problems.root_cause: Multiple gaps own the same file with opposite intents; one-file-per-compose; no cross-gap conflict check

problems.symptom: SA landings introduce defects: 30s shell cap, second spawn site, typecheck break, empty new_string rejection, gap flood
problems.root_cause: verify passes on typecheck and suite; no behavioral falsifier for primitives every other path depends on

problems.symptom: substrate lost its own measurement templates; recursive-fix deadlock
problems.root_cause: no self-detection of degradation; template registry not durable

problems.symptom: Autonomous landings break prod or truncate source (fetch monkey-patch, as-unknown cast, stale-test satisfaction, spectral-gap truncated in git)
